issues.title: [Bug] Project actions menu: Auto-discover dev server runs the first saved action instead of discovering a server

releases.name: v0.2.0
releases.notes:
## What this is

`skill_management` puts a control panel on the skills installed in your OpenCode setup. It can list them, explain why one is unavailable, hide one from the model, and bring it back.

Disabling never touches skill files: it writes a single `skill` permission rule into your global config (`effect: "deny"`, or `"ask"` for a soft disable). Nothing is deleted, moved or rewritten, and removing the rule restores the skill exactly as it was.

| Action | What it does | Writes config |
|---|---|---|
| `list` | Every registered skill with its effective state for the calling agent (`available` / `disabled` / `ask`) | no |
| `inspect` | Why one skill is (un)available: the matching rule, per-agent differences, how its id was derived | no |
| `disable` | Hide it from the model and reject loading it (`effect: "ask"` keeps it listed and asks on load) | yes |
| `enable` | Remove the blocking rule again, whoever wrote it | yes |

Install in one command: `opencode plugin add github:sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management` (details below).

## What's changed since v0.1.0

**Fixed — `list` reported the wrong state.** It merged every agent's permission rules before evaluating them, so deny rules owned by sub-agents (`explorer`, `title`, …) leaked into the caller's result: on a stock setup 28 of 29 skills showed up as `disabled` while `inspect` said they were available. en.headline: Published v0.2.0 for opencode-skill-management and opened one bug issue
en.summary: Today `sogeisetsu` published `v0.2.0` of `sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management`, with **19 own commits** plus 32 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]` across the day. In that repo, 11 own commits shipped idempotent publishing, rewrote the README around four actions, bumped `0.2.0`, added `tools/linux-verify.sh`, and documented Linux/WSL verification plus release-lifecycle checks. In `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox`, 4 own commits added knowledge entries for `chrome-devtools-mcp` and `eval-comparison` and evaluated MiniMax M3.1 Flash Free on a single-file pelican-bicycle demo. In `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, 4 own commits fixed release-table rendering, daily-report wording gates, manual `workflow_dispatch` for `check.yml`, and additive summary language. The user also opened issue #5293 in `openchamber/openchamber` about the auto-discover dev server running a saved action, and `openchamber-bot[bot]` replied that the cause was traced as `fix-ready`; totals were 19 commits, 0 PRs, 1 issue, and 0 reviews.

releaseNotes.summary: Released `v0.2.0` of `sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management`, adding a control panel for OpenCode skills with `list`, `inspect`, `disable`, and restore behavior. Disabling writes a `skill` permission rule with effect `deny` or `ask` into global config without touching skill files.

zh.headline: 发布 opencode-skill-management v0.2.0 并新开一个缺陷 issue
zh.summary: 今天 `sogeisetsu` 发布了 `sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management` 的 `v0.2.0`，全天共有 **19 次本人提交**，另有 32 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 自动提交。在该仓库中，11 次本人提交完成了幂等发布、重写面向使用者的 README、升级 `0.2.0`、新增 `tools/linux-verify.sh`，并补充 Linux/WSL 核验与发布生命周期验收记录。`sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` 的 4 次本人提交新增了 `chrome-devtools-mcp` 与 `eval-comparison` 知识条目，并评估 MiniMax M3.1 Flash Free 的单文件鹈鹕骑自行车演示。`sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 的 4 次本人提交修复了发布正文 GFM 表格渲染、日报措辞闸门、`check.yml` 手动补跑 `workflow_dispatch`，以及摘要必须相加的表述。用户还在 `openchamber/openchamber` 打开了 issue #5293，反馈自动发现开发服务器却运行了已保存动作的问题；`openchamber-bot[bot]` 回复称原因已追踪为 `fix-ready`。当日总计为 19 次提交、0 个 PR、1 个 issue、0 次评审。

releaseNotes.summary: 发布 `sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management` 的 `v0.2.0`，为 OpenCode 技能增加控制面板，支持 `list`、`inspect`、`disable` 与恢复。禁用会向全局配置写入 `skill` 权限规则，效果为 `deny` 或 `ask`，不改动技能文件。
